subject: SIG: Access controls evidence — SSO/SCIM/RBAC/MFA
messages:
From: Elena Torres <elena.torres@voltedge.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
Cc: security@voltedge.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG: Access controls — SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence request

Hi Aditya,

Thanks for agreeing to help on the SIG questionnaire for VoltEdge. We're working through the access controls section and need a few specific artifacts to close the item set on our end:

- Proof of SSO/SAML configuration (IdP-initiated SAML metadata or SAML integration doc)
- SCIM provisioning evidence (a sample provisioning event or audit log showing create/update/deprovision)
- RBAC role inventory that maps Redwood roles to least-privilege responsibilities
- MFA enforcement proof (policy + an authentication log sample showing enforcement)

Can you provide the documents or point me to a secure share with these items? If any of the artifacts need redaction, please flag the fields you will remove before sharing.

Target date for our audit window is Thu 2027-07-07; having this by EOD Mon 2027-06-28 would be ideal. Also open to a short 20-minute walkthrough if it helps.

Thanks,
Elena Torres
Senior Information Security Manager
VoltEdge Inc.
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@voltedge.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access controls — SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence request

Elena —

Appreciate the clear list. Looping in Dev and Marissa from Platform Security and Lauren from Customer Success; we'll assemble the artifacts and confirm redaction boundaries. High level: we can provide SAML metadata + redacted SP config, provisioning log excerpts (SCIM) with hashed user IDs, a role matrix export, and MFA policy plus a short log slice.

Plan:
1) Dev will pull the SCIM/audit excerpts and RBAC export.
2) Marissa will validate what needs redaction for customer-facing materials.
3) I will package the bundle and upload to a secure share with a short README.

If VoltEdge prefers, we can also set a 20-minute screen share to walk through live. Is Tue 2027-06-29 10:00 AM PT workable?

— Aditya
Director, Customer Security Integrations
Redwood Inference
From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood-inference.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access controls — SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence request

Aditya / Marissa —

Quick status: I've exported the following and attached redacted stubs for review:
- scim_provisioning_log_excerpt.csv (shows create/update/deprovision events for 2027-05-01 to 2027-05-07; user IDs hashed)
- rbac_role_inventory.xlsx (roles, permissions, owner)
- redacted_sso_config.pdf (SAML metadata with customer-specific fields removed)
- mfa_policy_screenshot.png (console capture of policy enforcement page)

Notes:
- SCIM logs are shipped with hashed identifiers and only event-level metadata to avoid PII. Full audit logs live in a restricted S3 bucket; we should not export the complete file without DLP review.
- RBAC export contains internal role descriptions (we need to ensure any service-account names that reference customer orgs are redacted).

I'll prepare a README that lists redactions and an index. Attaching the five example stubs for Marissa to review before we share externally.

— Dev
Lead Platform Engineer, Serving Runtime
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com>
To: dev_patel@redwood-inference.com, aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com
Date: Thu, 24 Jun 2027 11:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SIG: Access controls — SSO/SCIM/RBAC evidence request

Thanks Dev — look good as samples. A couple of clarification items before publishing externally:

- VoltEdge asked for 'least privilege mapping' — let's add a short mapping table that shows for the top five roles which permissions are intentionally excluded (e.g., no data export, no token creation). I can add that to the control_summary_slide_deck.pdf.
- For SSO proof, providing SAML metadata + a screenshot of the IdP trust entry is sufficient; avoid sharing certificate private material.
- For MFA, they typically accept either a policy page snapshot OR a 30-day log slice showing MFA challenges; given sensitivity we'll provide the policy snapshot and an aggregated count of MFA events rather than per-user logs.

Action: I'll update the slide deck and add an appendix with redaction notes. Aditya — confirm you want me to upload to the secure share once complete.

— Marissa
Senior Product Security Manager
From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood-inference.com>
To: Elena Torres <elena.torres@voltedge.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood-inference.com, marissa_cole@redwood-inference.com, lauren_bishop@redwood-inference.com
Date: Tue, 29 Jun 2027 08:14:00 -0700

Thanks for the patience. We've prepared a redacted evidence bundle and a short control summary. What we've included:

HubSpot ticket: https://app.hubspot.com/deals/9876

Best,
Aditya

Aditya —

Received the bundle and the share link; thank you. We reviewed the slide deck and the redaction notes — everything looks reasonable. Confirming the walkthrough for Tue 2027-06-29 10:00 AM PT works for our security team.

On two small follow-ups:
1) For the RBAC matrix, could you add in the 'escalation owner' for each role (even if a name placeholder) so our auditors can see who signs off on permission changes?
2) For SCIM deprovision events, can you confirm whether we can receive a signed statement that deprovisioning events are retained for 90 days? A short confirmatory note from your compliance team is sufficient.

If you can drop those two items into the same share before the walkthrough that would be ideal.

Thanks again — Elena
